title: SEALGuard: Safeguarding the Multilingual Conversations in Southeast Asian Languages for LLM Software Systems

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates the performance disparity of safety guardrails (specifically LlamaGuard and OpenAI Moderation) by comparing their Defense Success Rate (DSR), Precision, and F1-scores on unsafe and jailbreak prompts across English and nine Southeast Asian languages (Chinese, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Thai, Khmer, Lao, Malay, Burmese, and Tagalog).
